title: PoA Act 1989 and PCR Act 1955
quote: 2018 sequence: Mahajan → Sec. 18A → review → Chauhan upheld

boxes.title: Key sections
head: Section
Provision
rows: No preliminary enquiry or approval before arrest

items.what: ==**Subhash Kashinath Mahajan**==: preliminary inquiry by **DSP**; anticipatory bail
**Kiran v Rajkumar Jivaraj Jain**: no "mini-trial" at bail

boxes.title: 2015 Amendment (in force 2016)
items: New atrocities: **tonsuring**, garlanding with footwear, **devadasi** dedication
**Exclusive Special Courts**; trial within **two months** of charge sheet
New chapter: **rights of victims and witnesses**

boxes.title: Manual scavenging
items: **2013** Act: sewer/septic cleaning without gear; **cognizable and non-bailable**
**Safai Karamchari Andolan** (**2014**): ==**₹10 lakh**== per sewer death → **₹30 lakh** (2023, Balram Singh)

boxes.title: Data & AP
items: AP: **14 Special Sessions Courts + 1 Exclusive Court** (Laxmipet)

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Case "alleged to have diluted" the Act = ==**Subhash Kashinath Mahajan**== (G2 2024)
PCR offences: **cognizable** - summary trial and non-compoundable both accepted (MPPSC 2019)
